notes.title: UPCOMING PROLOGUE! 🍔
notes.content:
[h1][b]Dear gourmets! 👩‍🍳👨‍🍳[/b][/h1]

[h3]We have great news for you - [b]the prologue for ASMR Food Experience is coming[/b]! The prologue is a great 'snack' that will introduce you to the first stages of the game. 🥳[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2358590/ASMR_Food_Experience_Prologue/

[h3]ASMR Food Experience: Prologue is nothing more than delicious dishes, and addictive gameplay in which taste and sound are inseparable elements. Get ready for a unique experience that will take you to the magical world of sensual experiences. 😊[/h3]

For those who want to sample the great flavors and sounds of ASMR Food Experience, the prologue is the perfect way to start. The prologue will allow you to get acquainted with the game before its official release. Best of all, the prologue will be available for free!

[b]So, prepare your taste buds for an amazing experience that will put you in an amazing mood.[/b]

[b]You can add the prologue to your Steam Wishlist[/b] so you don't miss the latest news about the game's development. So, get ready for delicious sensations and sounds that will put you in a fantastic mood. Be ready for a culinary experience that will take you to a new dimension of taste and sound! 🎧

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43973550/037ec6677f8d75ecb4f861a698c4795f500068ab.gif[/img]

[h3][b]If you have any questions feel free to chat with us on our Discord! 👇[/b][/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/aZCYENsGKE][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42655126/4dadcda3a20b495658e1be8fa728a0d6b36dd7b7.png[/img][/url]

See you soon,
ASMR Food Experience Team
